verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֨ה אֵלַ֜י בַּשָּׁנָ֤ה הַתְּשִׁיעִית֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י בֶּעָשׂ֥וֹר לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay baš·šā·nāh hat·tə·šî·‘îṯ ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·‘ă·śî·rî be·‘ā·śō·wr la·ḥō·ḏeš lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the ninth year on the tenth day of the tenth month the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Demais, no nono ano, no décimo mês, aos dez dias do mês, veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם כְּתוֹב לְךָ֙ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם הַיּ֔וֹם אֶת־ עֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה סָמַ֤ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ אֶל־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām kə·ṯōḇ lə·ḵā ’eṯ- šêm hay·yō·wm ’eṯ- ‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh sā·maḵ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Son of man write down . . . - today’s date for on this very day the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem -
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, escreve o nome do dia, sim, deste mesmo dia; o rei de Babilônia aproximou-se de Jerusalém neste dia.

verses.original: וּמְשֹׁ֤ל אֶל־ בֵּית־ הַמֶּ֙רִי֙ מָשָׁ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה שְׁפֹ֤ת הַסִּיר֙ שְׁפֹ֔ת וְגַם־ יְצֹ֥ק בּ֖וֹ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·šōl ’el- bêṯ- ham·me·rî mā·šāl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh šə·p̄ōṯ has·sîr šə·p̄ōṯ wə·ḡam- yə·ṣōq bōw mā·yim
verses.literal: Now speak a parable . . . to this rebellious house and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says Put the pot on the fire put it on and pour in the water
verses.literalPt: Propõe uma parábola à casa rebelde e dize-lhes: Assim diz Jeová Deus: Põe a caldeira ao lume, põe-na e deita-lhe também água dentro;

verses.original: אֱסֹ֤ף נְתָחֶ֙יהָ֙ אֵלֶ֔יהָ כָּל־ נֵ֥תַח ט֖וֹב יָרֵ֣ךְ וְכָתֵ֑ף מִבְחַ֥ר עֲצָמִ֖ים מַלֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·sōp̄ nə·ṯā·ḥe·hā ’ê·le·hā kāl- nê·ṯaḥ ṭō·wḇ yā·rêḵ wə·ḵā·ṯêp̄ miḇ·ḥar ‘ă·ṣā·mîm mal·lê
verses.literal: Put in the pieces of meat every good piece thigh and shoulder fill it with choice bones
verses.literalPt: Mete nela os seus pedaços, a saber, todos os bons pedaços, a coxa e a espádua; enche-a dos ossos escolhidos.

verses.original: מִבְחַ֤ר הַצֹּאן֙ לָק֔וֹחַ וְגַ֛ם דּ֥וּר הָעֲצָמִ֖ים תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ רַתַּ֣ח רְתָחֶ֔יהָ גַּם־ בָּשְׁל֥וּ עֲצָמֶ֖יהָ בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: miḇ·ḥar haṣ·ṣōn lā·qō·w·aḥ wə·ḡam dūr hā·‘ă·ṣā·mîm taḥ·te·hā rat·taḥ rə·ṯā·ḥe·hā gam- bā·šə·lū ‘ă·ṣā·me·hā bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: Take the choicest of the flock and pile the fuel beneath it Bring it to a boil . . . and cook the bones in it
verses.literalPt: Toma o que é de melhor do rebanho e põe também uma pilha dos ossos debaixo dela; faze-a ferver bem, sim, sejam cozidos os seus ossos no meio dela.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה אוֹי֮ עִ֣יר הַדָּמִים֒ סִ֚יר אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֶלְאָתָ֣ה בָ֔הּ וְחֶ֨לְאָתָ֔הּ לֹ֥א יָצְאָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נָּה לִנְתָחֶ֤יהָ לִנְתָחֶ֙יהָ֙ הוֹצִיאָ֔הּ לֹא־ נָפַ֥ל עָלֶ֖יהָ גּוֹרָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ō·w ‘îr had·dā·mîm sîr ’ă·šer ḥel·’ā·ṯāh ḇāh wə·ḥel·’ā·ṯāh lō yā·ṣə·’āh mim·men·nāh lin·ṯā·ḥe·hā lin·ṯā·ḥe·hā hō·w·ṣî·’āh lō- nā·p̄al ‘ā·le·hā gō·w·rāl
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Woe to the city of bloodshed to the pot now rusted whose rust will not come off . . . Empty it piece by piece cast no lots for its contents
verses.literalPt: Pelo que assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Ai da cidade sanguinolenta, da caldeira cheia de ferrugem e cuja ferrugem não saiu dela! Esvazia-se pedaço por pedaço; não caiu sorte sobre ela.

verses.original: כִּ֤י דָמָהּ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֣הּ הָיָ֔ה עַל־ צְחִ֥יחַ סֶ֖לַע שָׂמָ֑תְהוּ לֹ֤א שְׁפָכַ֙תְהוּ֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לְכַסּ֥וֹת עָלָ֖יו עָפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḏā·māh bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh hā·yāh ‘al- ṣə·ḥî·aḥ se·la‘ śā·mā·ṯə·hū lō šə·p̄ā·ḵaṯ·hū ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ ‘ā·lāw ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: For the blood she shed is still within her she poured it out on the bare rock she did not pour it on the ground to cover . . . it with dust
verses.literalPt: Pois o seu sangue está no meio dela; ela o pôs sobre a rocha escalvada, não o derramou sobre o chão, para o cobrir com o pó;

verses.original: לְהַעֲל֤וֹת חֵמָה֙ לִנְקֹ֣ם נָקָ֔ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ דָּמָ֖הּ עַל־ צְחִ֣יחַ סָ֑לַע לְבִלְתִּ֖י הִכָּסֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ḥê·māh lin·qōm nā·qām nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- dā·māh ‘al- ṣə·ḥî·aḥ sā·la‘ lə·ḇil·tî hik·kā·sō·wṯ
verses.literal: In order to stir up wrath and take vengeance . . . I have placed her blood on the bare rock so that it would not be covered
verses.literalPt: a fim de que ele fizesse subir a fúria para tomar vingança, pus o sangue dela sobre a rocha escalvada, para que não fosse coberto.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה א֖וֹי עִ֣יר הַדָּמִ֑ים גַּם־ אֲנִ֖י אַגְדִּ֥יל הַמְּדוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ō·w ‘îr had·dā·mîm gam- ’ă·nî ’aḡ·dîl ham·mə·ḏū·rāh
verses.literal: Yes this is what the Lord GOD says Woe to the city of bloodshed . . . I, too will pile the kindling high
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Ai da cidade sanguinolenta! Eu também farei grande a pilha.

verses.original: הַרְבֵּ֤ה הָעֵצִים֙ הַדְלֵ֣ק הָאֵ֔שׁ הָתֵ֖ם הַבָּשָׂ֑ר וְהַרְקַח֙ הַמֶּרְקָחָ֔ה וְהָעֲצָמ֖וֹת יֵחָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: har·bêh hā·‘ê·ṣîm haḏ·lêq hā·’êš hā·ṯêm hab·bā·śār wə·har·qaḥ ham·mer·qā·ḥāh wə·hā·‘ă·ṣā·mō·wṯ yê·ḥā·rū
verses.literal: Pile on the logs and kindle the fire cook the meat well and mix in the spices let the bones be burned
verses.literalPt: Amontoa a lenha, torna mais quente o fogo, ferve bem a carne, faze grosso o caldo, e sejam queimados os ossos.

verses.original: וְהַעֲמִידֶ֥הָ עַל־ גֶּחָלֶ֖יהָ רֵקָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן תֵּחַ֜ם וְחָ֣רָה נְחֻשְׁתָּ֗הּ וְנִתְּכָ֤ה בְתוֹכָהּ֙ טֻמְאָתָ֔הּ תִּתֻּ֖ם חֶלְאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·‘ă·mî·ḏe·hā ‘al- ge·ḥā·le·hā rê·qāh lə·ma·‘an tê·ḥam wə·ḥā·rāh nə·ḥuš·tāh wə·nit·tə·ḵāh ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh ṭum·’ā·ṯāh tit·tum ḥel·’ā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Set the empty pot on its coals until it becomes hot and its copper glows Then its impurity will melt within its rust will be consumed
verses.literalPt: Então, põe-na vazia sobre as suas brasas, para que ela aqueça, o seu cobre se derreta, e se funda no meio dela a sua imundícia, a fim de que se consuma a sua ferrugem.

verses.original: תְּאֻנִ֖ים הֶלְאָ֑ת וְלֹֽא־ תֵצֵ֤א מִמֶּ֙נָּה֙ רַבַּ֣ת חֶלְאָתָ֔הּ בְּאֵ֖שׁ חֶלְאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·’u·nîm hel·’āṯ wə·lō- ṯê·ṣê mim·men·nāh rab·baṯ ḥel·’ā·ṯāh bə·’êš ḥel·’ā·ṯāh
verses.literal: It has frustrated every effort its thick rust has not been removed . . . even by the fire
verses.literalPt: Ela tem-se cansado com trabalhos; contudo, não sai dela a sua muita ferrugem. A sua ferrugem não sai por meio do fogo.

verses.original: בְּטֻמְאָתֵ֖ךְ זִמָּ֑ה יַ֤עַן טִֽהַרְתִּיךְ֙ וְלֹ֣א טָהַ֔רְתְּ מִטֻּמְאָתֵךְ֙ לֹ֣א תִטְהֲרִי־ ע֔וֹד עַד־ הֲנִיחִ֥י אֶת־ חֲמָתִ֖י בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭum·’ā·ṯêḵ zim·māh ya·‘an ṭi·har·tîḵ wə·lō ṭā·hart miṭ·ṭum·’ā·ṯêḵ lō ṯiṭ·hă·rî- ‘ō·wḏ ‘aḏ- hă·nî·ḥî ’eṯ- ḥă·mā·ṯî bāḵ
verses.literal: Because of the indecency of your uncleanness I tried to cleanse you but you would not be purified from your filthiness You will not be pure again until My wrath against you has subsided
verses.literalPt: Há luxúria na tua imundícia; porque te purifiquei e não foste purificada, não serás purificada nunca da tua imundícia, até que eu tenha satisfeito o meu furor sobre ti.

verses.original: אֲנִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה דִּבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ בָּאָ֣ה וְעָשִׂ֔יתִי לֹֽא־ אֶפְרַ֥ע וְלֹא־ אָח֖וּס וְלֹ֣א אֶנָּחֵ֑ם כִּדְרָכַ֤יִךְ וְכַעֲלִילוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ שְׁפָט֔וּךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh dib·bar·tî bā·’āh wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî lō- ’ep̄·ra‘ wə·lō- ’ā·ḥūs wə·lō ’en·nā·ḥêm kiḏ·rā·ḵa·yiḵ wə·ḵa·‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯa·yiḵ šə·p̄ā·ṭūḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: I the LORD have spoken the time is coming and I will act I will not refrain or show pity nor will I relent I will judge you according to your ways and deeds declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Eu, Jeová, o disse: sucederá, e eu o farei; não me tornarei para trás, nem pouparei, nem me arrependerei; conforme os teus caminhos e conforme os teus feitos, te julgarão, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Também veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הִנְנִ֨י לֹקֵ֧חַ מִמְּךָ֛ אֶת־ מַחְמַ֥ד עֵינֶ֖יךָ בְּמַגֵּפָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א תִסְפֹּד֙ וְלֹ֣א תִבְכֶּ֔ה וְל֥וֹא תָב֖וֹא דִּמְעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām hin·nî lō·qê·aḥ mim·mə·ḵā ’eṯ- maḥ·maḏ ‘ê·ne·ḵā bə·mag·gê·p̄āh wə·lō ṯis·pōḏ wə·lō ṯiḇ·keh wə·lō·w ṯā·ḇō·w dim·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Son of man behold I am about to take away the desire of your eyes . . . with a fatal blow But you must not mourn . . . or weep . . . or let your tears flow
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, eis que eu tiro dum golpe o desejo dos teus olhos; todavia, não te lamentarás, nem chorarás, nem te correrão lágrimas.

verses.original: הֵאָנֵ֣ק׀ דֹּ֗ם מֵתִים֙ אֵ֣בֶל לֹֽא־ תַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה פְאֵֽרְךָ֙ חֲב֣וֹשׁ עָלֶ֔יךָ וּנְעָלֶ֖יךָ תָּשִׂ֣ים בְּרַגְלֶ֑יךָ וְלֹ֤א תַעְטֶה֙ עַל־ שָׂפָ֔ם וְלֶ֥חֶם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hê·’ā·nêq dōm mê·ṯîm ’ê·ḇel lō- ṯa·‘ă·śeh p̄ə·’ê·rə·ḵā ḥă·ḇō·wōš ‘ā·le·ḵā ū·nə·‘ā·le·ḵā tā·śîm bə·raḡ·le·ḵā wə·lō ṯa‘·ṭeh ‘al- śā·p̄ām wə·le·ḥem ’ă·nā·šîm lō ṯō·ḵêl
verses.literal: Groan quietly do not mourn for the dead Put on your turban and strap your sandals on your feet do not cover . . . your lips or eat the bread of mourners . . .
verses.literalPt: Geme, porém, em silêncio; não faças lamentação pelos mortos, ata na cabeça o teu turbante, e mete nos pés os teus sapatos, e não cubras os teus lábios, e não comas o pão dos homens.

verses.original: וָאֲדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל־ הָעָם֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַתָּ֥מָת אִשְׁתִּ֖י בָּעָ֑רֶב וָאַ֥עַשׂ בַּבֹּ֖קֶר כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צֻוֵּֽיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ḏab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ām bab·bō·qer wat·tā·māṯ ’iš·tî bā·‘ā·reḇ wā·’a·‘aś bab·bō·qer ka·’ă·šer ṣuw·wê·ṯî
verses.literal: So I spoke to the people in the morning and in the evening my wife died And the next morning I did as I had been commanded
verses.literalPt: Assim, falei de manhã ao povo, e à tarde morreu minha mulher; e fiz, pela manhã, como se me deu ordem.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלַ֖י הָעָ֑ם הֲלֹֽא־ תַגִּ֥יד לָ֙נוּ֙ מָה־ אֵ֣לֶּה לָּ֔נוּ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lay hā·‘ām hă·lō- ṯag·gîḏ lā·nū māh- ’êl·leh lā·nū kî ’at·tāh ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: Then the people asked me . . . Won’t you tell us what these things . . . you are doing mean to us
verses.literalPt: O povo perguntou-me: Porventura, não nos farás saber o que nos significam essas coisas, visto que tu procedes desta maneira?

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם דְּבַ֨ר־ יְהוָ֔ה הָיָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·lê·hem də·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: So I answered them The word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Então, lhes respondi: A palavra de Jeová veio a mim, dizendo:

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר׀ לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנְנִ֨י מְחַלֵּ֤ל אֶת־ מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּכֶ֔ם מַחְמַ֥ד עֵֽינֵיכֶ֖ם וּמַחְמַ֣ל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּבְנֵיכֶ֧ם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתֶּ֖ם בַּחֶ֥רֶב יִפֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî mə·ḥal·lêl ’eṯ- miq·dā·šî gə·’ō·wn ‘uz·zə·ḵem maḥ·maḏ ‘ê·nê·ḵem ū·maḥ·mal nap̄·šə·ḵem ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer ‘ă·zaḇ·tem ba·ḥe·reḇ yip·pō·lū
verses.literal: Tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD . . . says I am about to desecrate My sanctuary the pride of your power the desire of your eyes and the delight of your soul And the sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword
verses.literalPt: Fala à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Eis que profanarei o meu santuário, orgulho do vosso poder, desejo dos vossos olhos, e o de que se condói a vossa alma; vossos filhos e vossas filhas, que deixastes, cairão à espada.

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי עַל־ שָׂפָם֙ לֹ֣א תַעְט֔וּ וְלֶ֥חֶם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî ‘al- śā·p̄ām lō ṯa‘·ṭū wə·le·ḥem ’ă·nā·šîm lō ṯō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Then you will do as I have done . . . You will not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners . . .
verses.literalPt: Vós fareis como eu fiz: não vos cobrireis os lábios, nem comereis o pão dos homens.

verses.original: וּפְאֵרֵכֶ֣ם עַל־ רָאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְנַֽעֲלֵיכֶם֙ בְּרַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תִסְפְּד֖וּ וְלֹ֣א תִבְכּ֑וּ וּנְמַקֹּתֶם֙ בַּעֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּנְהַמְתֶּ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·’ê·rê·ḵem ‘al- rā·šê·ḵem wə·na·‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·raḡ·lê·ḵem lō ṯis·pə·ḏū wə·lō ṯiḇ·kū ū·nə·maq·qō·ṯem ba·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·ḵem ū·nə·ham·tem ’îš ’el- ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: Your turbans will remain on your heads and your sandals on your feet You will not mourn or weep but you will waste away because of your sins and you will groan among . . . yourselves
verses.literalPt: Tereis nas cabeças os vossos turbantes e nos pés, os vossos sapatos. Não vos lamentareis, nem chorareis, mas definhar-vos-eis nas vossas iniquidades, e dareis gemidos uns com os outros.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה יְחֶזְקֵ֤אל לָכֶם֙ לְמוֹפֵ֔ת כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ בְּבֹאָ֕הּ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh yə·ḥez·qêl lā·ḵem lə·mō·w·p̄êṯ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ta·‘ă·śū bə·ḇō·’āh wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ’ă·nî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign for you you will do everything that he has done When this happens you will know that I am the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Assim, vos servirá Ezequiel de sinal; conforme tudo o que ele fez, assim fareis vós. Quando isso suceder, sabereis que eu sou o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם הֲל֗וֹא בְּי֨וֹם קַחְתִּ֤י מֵהֶם֙ אֶת־ מָ֣עוּזָּ֔ם מְשׂ֖וֹשׂ תִּפְאַרְתָּ֑ם אֶת־ מַחְמַ֤ד עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת־ מַשָּׂ֣א נַפְשָׁ֔ם בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hă·lō·w bə·yō·wm qaḥ·tî mê·hem ’eṯ- mā·‘ūz·zām mə·śō·wś tip̄·’ar·tām ’eṯ- maḥ·maḏ ‘ê·nê·hem wə·’eṯ- maś·śā nap̄·šām bə·nê·hem ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: And you son of man . . . know that on the day I take away their stronghold their pride and joy the desire of their eyes which uplifted their souls and their sons and daughters as well
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, no dia em que eu lhes tirar a sua fortaleza, o gozo da sua glória, o desejo dos seus olhos e aquilo em que eles põem a sua mente, isto é, seus filhos e suas filhas,

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יָב֥וֹא הַפָּלִ֖יט אֵלֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁמָע֖וּת אָזְנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yā·ḇō·w hap·pā·lîṭ ’ê·le·ḵā lə·haš·mā·‘ūṯ ’ā·zə·nā·yim
verses.literal: on that day a fugitive will come and tell you the news . . .
verses.literalPt: porventura, não será nesse dia que virá ter contigo todo aquele que escapar, para to fazer ouvir com os teus ouvidos?

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִפָּ֤תַח פִּ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ הַפָּלִ֔יט וּתְדַבֵּ֕ר וְלֹ֥א תֵֽאָלֵ֖ם ע֑וֹד וְהָיִ֤יתָ לָהֶם֙ לְמוֹפֵ֔ת וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yip·pā·ṯaḥ pî·ḵā ’eṯ- hap·pā·lîṭ ū·ṯə·ḏab·bêr wə·lō ṯê·’ā·lêm ‘ō·wḏ wə·hā·yî·ṯā lā·hem lə·mō·w·p̄êṯ wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: On that day your mouth . . . will be opened to him who has escaped you will speak and no longer be mute So you will be a sign to them and they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, se te abrirá a boca para o que tiver escapado, e falarás e não ficarás mais em silêncio. Assim, lhes servirás de sinal; e saberão que eu sou Jeová.
